title: Kathmandu public rate research for the 51 original Pilates items
policy: Original estimate and SI values remain unchanged.
Public references are not quotations for the exact design. No arbitrary midpoint or market grand total is produced.
Material-only, labour-only, retail and installed scope remain distinct.
Each-to-area and fabric-length-to-area conversions are prohibited without dimensions.
Unknown VAT and current availability stay unknown. Historical and indexed-only prices are labeled.
V5 comparison charts and V6 item imagery have not been created.
